```artifact
## UML Testing Profile (UTP)

**Test Suite Name:** Consultation Request and Management

**Target Application:** Virtual Healthcare System

**Test Objective:** Verify the functionality of consultation request generation, diagnosis, prescription, medication delivery, lab report collection and update, and user management features.

**Test Scope:** Unit U04_2

**Test Cases:**

| Test Case ID | Title | Requirement ID(s) | Test Type | Preconditions | Inputs | Steps | Expected Results |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| TC-001 | Patient generates consultation request | VIRTUA-2.2-5 | Positive | Patient is logged in | Consultation request details | Patient submits request | Doctor receives request and sees it in their dashboard |
| TC-002 | Doctor diagnoses patient | VIRTUA-2.2-5 | Positive | Doctor is logged in and has received a request | Consultation details | Doctor diagnoses patient and provides a diagnosis | Patient receives notification of diagnosis and can view it in their account |
| TC-003 | Doctor generates prescription | VIRTUA-2.2-6 | Positive | Doctor has diagnosed a patient | Diagnosis details | Doctor creates a prescription | Prescription is sent to patient, chemist, and labs |
| TC-004 | Chemist receives prescription and delivers medication | VIRTUA-2.2-7 | Positive | Chemist is logged in | Prescription details | Chemist receives prescription and verifies medication details | Chemist delivers medication to patient |
| TC-005 | Lab receives prescription and collects specimen | VIRTUA-2.2-8 | Positive | Lab is logged in | Prescription details | Lab receives prescription and collects specimen from patient | Lab generates lab report and sends it to patient and updates report in system |
| TC-006 | Patient receives lab report | VIRTUA-2.2-8 | Positive | Patient is logged in | Lab report notification | Patient receives lab report | Patient can view lab report in their account |
| TC-007 | Admin sets up specialties | VIRTUA-2.3-1 | Positive | Admin is logged in | Specialty details | Admin creates a new specialty | New specialty is added to the system |
| TC-008 | Admin adds doctor | VIRTUA-2.3-2 | Positive | Admin is logged in | Doctor details | Admin creates a new doctor account | New doctor is added to the system |
| TC-009 | Admin adds lab | VIRTUA-2.3-3 | Positive | Admin is logged in | Lab details | Admin creates a new lab account | New lab is added to the system |
| TC-010 | Admin edits doctor information | VIRTUA-2.3-4 | Positive | Admin is logged in | Doctor ID and updated details | Admin edits doctor information | Doctor information is updated in the system |
```
